timeline.summary: On 23 April 2026, NIIT Learning Systems said it had filed a Section 154 rectification application and a CIT(A) appeal against the AY2023-24 faceless-assessment demand first disclosed on 27 March 2026, which it attributes to computation-sheet errors including short credit of prepaid taxes.
On 7 May 2026, NIIT Learning Systems announced an earnings call for FY26 results on May 12, 2026.

NIIT Learning Systems Limited’s **Mr. Sapnesh Kumar Lalla (Non-Deal Executive Director & CEO)** and **Mr. Kapil Saurabh (Head M&A & Investor Relations)** will host in-person investor roadshow meetings on **May 15, 2026 (9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Mumbai)** per SEBI Regulation 30.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹525.22 Cr, net profit ₹77.11 Cr.
NIIT Learning Systems Limited hosted an investors/analysts call on May 12, 2026, following audited FY2026 results declaration, with audio available via provided link.
On 18 May 2026, NIIT Learning Systems submitted the transcript of the Q4 and FY26 earnings investor call held on 12 May 2026.
On May 19, 2026, NIIT Learning Systems announced a strategic partnership with Visier to offer AI-powered workforce intelligence solutions in the UK and Europe.
On June 6, 2026, NIIT Learning Systems announced a capital restructuring of its step-down subsidiary, NIIT Learning Solutions (Canada) Ltd, to return excess cash.
